stories.summary_en: NASA's Swift observatory made its final observation on October 20 and is expected to re-enter the atmosphere in the next few weeks after a failed rescue attempt over the summer. Designed to study gamma-ray bursts, Swift was launched on November 20, 2004, on a two-year mission.
stories.summary_zh: NASA 的雨燕天文台于 10 月 20 日进行了最终观测，预计在夏季救援尝试失败后将在未来几周内重新进入大气层。 Swift 旨在研究伽马射线暴，于 2004 年 11 月 20 日发射升空，执行为期两年的任务。

stories.title_en: A 2,700-year-old solar eclipse just revealed something surprising about Earth
stories.title_zh: 2700年前的日食刚刚揭示了地球的一些令人惊讶的事情
stories.summary_en: A solar eclipse recorded more than 2,700 years ago is revealing surprising secrets about Earth's rotation and the Sun's ancient behavior. By correcting an eight-kilometer error in the location of an ancient Chinese capital, scientists were able to reconstruct a total solar eclipse that occurred in 709 BCE and obtain more accurate measurements of how fast Earth was spinning at the time.
stories.summary_zh: 2700 多年前记录的一次日食正在揭示有关地球自转和太阳古代行为的惊人秘密。通过纠正中国古都位置八公里的误差，科学家们能够重建公元前 709 年发生的日全食，并更准确地测量当时地球自转的速度。

stories.title_en: Chinese scientists discover “D-rex,” a giant fungus with roots stretching back 65 million years
stories.title_zh: 中国科学家发现“D-rex”巨型真菌，其根系可追溯到6500万年前
stories.summary_en: Scientists have discovered a giant new fungus in China that grows up to 20 inches tall and weighs nearly five pounds, making it the largest known of its kind. Dubbed “D-rex,” its evolutionary lineage appears to have emerged shortly after the dinosaurs went extinct, raising intriguing questions about how that ancient catastrophe may have shaped its evolution.
stories.summary_zh: 科学家在中国发现了一种巨大的新真菌，它可以长到 20 英寸高，重近 5 磅，是已知的同类中最大的。它被称为“霸王龙”，它的进化谱系似乎是在恐龙灭绝后不久出现的，这引发了关于这场古老的灾难可能如何影响它的进化的有趣问题。
